source.chapter_title: Results of the Antardasas in the Mahadasa of Rahu

notes: Each antardasha is judged from the sub-period lord's dignity and house, and its position counted from the mahadasha lord. Warnings attached to lordship of the 2nd/7th (maraka), named diseases, deaths and the remedial rituals that close each section are omitted under the sensitive-topics policy.

rules.text: Rahu-Rahu: with Rahu in Cancer, Scorpio or Sagittarius, or in the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th under benefic influence — honours from authority, clothes, vehicles and ornaments, large business profits (notably on journeys to the west), high enthusiasm, comfort from the spouse and an addition to the family.
Rahu-Rahu: with Rahu in the 8th or 12th — grief from theft or injury, conflict with officials, and trouble around siblings, spouse and children.

Rahu-Jupiter: with Jupiter in an angle or trine, or exalted or in its own sign — land, patience, rivals overcome, abundant happiness, warmth from authority and steady progress like a waxing Moon; vehicles and wealth; journeys west or south-east, a return home, ambitions accomplished, pilgrimage and devotion, and celebration at the birth of a child.

variants.text: A strong Jupiter well placed from Rahu: additions of house and land, money and clothes, and a turn towards charity and spiritual pursuits; the last two months bring friction with authority and worry over elders.

rules.text: Rahu-Jupiter: Jupiter debilitated, combust, in an enemy's sign or in the 6th, 8th or 12th, and under malefic influence — loss of money, interruptions at work, damage to reputation and trouble for spouse and children.
Rahu-Jupiter: Jupiter in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu or with malefics — loss of money and physical strain.

Rahu-Saturn: with Saturn in an angle, trine, the 3rd or 11th, or exalted or in moolatrikona — satisfying service to those in power, a wedding or other auspicious function, development of gardens and water works, and travel west; but also lethargy, a dip in income, and a return home.

Rahu-Saturn: with Saturn debilitated, in an enemy's sign, in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or with malefics — hostility from subordinates, trouble with authority, strain on spouse, children and siblings, disputes with co-heirs and complications in business, though with a sudden gain of ornaments.

variants.text: Saturn is also in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu: disrepute, trouble from opponents, travel to other countries, poor diet and grief from one's own community; health needs care.

rules.text: Rahu-Mercury: with Mercury in the 9th or an angle, or exalted or in its own sign — the results of a raja yoga: auspicious occasions at home, gains in business, higher education, a good vehicle, weddings, comfort in relationships, a high reputation and large profits through official favour.

variants.text: Mercury is also well placed from Rahu: good health, a glad heart, goals achieved, religious study and discourse, marriage, charity and compassion.

rules.text: Rahu-Mercury: Mercury in the 6th, 8th or 12th (from the ascendant or from Rahu) with Saturn's or a malefic's influence — irreverence, a decline in diet and fortune, losses through blunt speech, poor judgement, needless quarrels, reprimand from authority, risk of theft, and anguish for spouse and children.
Rahu-Ketu: in general a period of travel, worry over authority, loss of livestock and health needing care.

variants.text: Ketu is joined or aspected by a benefic: instead good health, money, official honours, ornaments and festivity at home.
Ketu is linked with the ascendant lord: success in chosen aims, happiness and a definite gain of money.
Ketu is with the 8th lord: pain and anguish.
Ketu in the 6th, 8th or 12th: trouble from theft or injury, worry for the parents, conflict with siblings and distress.

rules.text: Rahu-Venus: with Venus in an angle, trine or the 11th — wealth through learned people, livestock, celebration at a child's birth, happiness at home, honours from society and authority, and great comfort.

variants.text: Venus exalted or in its own sign: a new house, fine food, more comfort for spouse and children, entertaining friends, generous giving, a vehicle, clothes and ornaments through official favour, high business profits, a wedding, and a child starting school.
Venus is also well placed from Rahu: great goodwill from the local administration, comforts, music and song, and marks of rank.

rules.text: Rahu-Venus: with Venus in the 6th, 8th or 12th, debilitated, in an enemy's sign, or with Saturn or Mars — quarrels without cause, grief around father and children, litigation, and suffering for spouse and children; health needs care.

variants.text: Venus with malefics in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu: fear of authority and theft, joyless food, mental anguish, and loss of money through restriction or official action.

rules.text: Rahu-Sun: with the Sun dignified, in an angle, trine or the 11th, or aspected by benefics — wealth and prosperity through official favour, moderate but pleasing recognition, local administrative charge and moderate gains.

variants.text: The Sun with the 9th or ascendant lord and aspected by the 10th lord: official recognition, high reputation, foreign travel, wide authority, vehicles, clothes and ornaments, plans fulfilled and the children's welfare.
The Sun well placed from Rahu: an honoured reception abroad and prosperity.

rules.text: Rahu-Sun: a debilitated Sun in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu — quarrels, confrontation with authority, travel, more opponents and losses through officials, theft or fire; health needs care.

Rahu-Moon: with the Moon dignified or in an angle, trine or the 11th — gains through government, lucrative profits, good health, ornaments, happiness from friends, spouse and children, vehicles, more houses and land, and recognition; fullest when the Moon is bright.

variants.text: The Moon is also well placed from Rahu: a sense of grace and a pleasant atmosphere at home, success in every venture, wealth, high reputation and an inclination to worship.

rules.text: Rahu-Moon: a weak Moon in the 6th, 8th or 12th — irrational fears, loss of house or farmland, and risk of theft or injury while travelling.

Rahu-Mars: Mars in an angle, trine or the 11th, or exalted or in its own sign, with benefic support — recovery of a lost position, expansion of house and land, comfort through children, fine food, ornaments, vehicles and clothes.

variants.text: Mars is also well placed from Rahu: travel, a meeting with authority, the children's prosperity, promotion to command and profit through siblings.

rules.text: Rahu-Mars: Mars with malefics in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu — distress and confrontation involving children, spouse and siblings, loss of home or place, and risk of theft or injury; the start is the hardest part.
